description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Foreign Exchange regulations, Act No. 12 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette content is an order issued under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, which establishes new regulatory measures and compliance requirements for foreign exchange transactions. It suspends certain types of outward payments and remittances, limits migration allowances, and grants specific authorities to the Monetary Board. This constitutes a regulatory framework modification under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5). While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa as the issuing authority, it does not focus on his appointment or government structure, but rather on the substantive regulatory changes being implemented.
